citations.quote: Name: Fizz. Official role tags: Assassin, Fighter.
Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable.

core_mechanics.summary: His spear hop makes him untargetable.

citations.quote: After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside.

purpose: Recognize Fizz's fighting pattern and main defensive timing.
title: Fizz

citations.quote: The damage reduction is increased to 14 (+ 1% AP) against monsters.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Damage reduction is increased against monsters.

citations.quote: Fizz can move through units
takes slightly reduced damage from all hits.

core_mechanics.summary: Takes slightly reduced damage from all hits.

purpose: Recognize passive movement freedom and damage reduction.
title: Nimble Fighter

citations.quote: Urchin Strike can only go through walls if the target is on the other side.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Crossing a wall requires the target to be on the other side.

citations.quote: Seastone Trident and Chum the Waters can be cast during the dash.

advanced_exceptions.summary: W and R can be cast during the dash.

citations.quote: Fizz dashes a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy.

core_mechanics.summary: Fixed-distance dash toward a target enemy.

citations.quote: If they are in range upon arrival, he deals magic damage plus 100% AD physical damage and applies on-hit effects.

core_mechanics.summary: Deals mixed damage and applies on-hit effects if the target is in range on arrival.

purpose: Recognize the targeted dash and its attack-effect delivery.
title: Urchin Strike

citations.quote: Fizz's basic attacks rend enemies on-hit, dealing magic damage every 0.5 seconds over 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

core_mechanics.summary: Attacks apply a refreshing magic-damage bleed.

citations.quote: Fizz empowers his next basic attack to deal bonus magic damage
Seastone Trident resets Fizz's basic attack timer.

core_mechanics.summary: Empowers the next attack and resets the attack timer.

citations.quote: If this attack kills the target, the cooldown is reduced and the mana cost is refunded.

core_mechanics.summary: An empowered attack kill reduces cooldown and refunds mana.

citations.quote: If this attack does not kill the target, Fizz's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage for a few seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: Without a kill, subsequent attacks briefly gain bonus magic damage.

purpose: Recognize empowered attacks, bleed and conditional follow-up.
title: Seastone Trident

citations.quote: Both Playful's and Trickster's dashes may be directed separately.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The dashes can be directed separately.

citations.quote: Fizz vaults in the target direction and balances onto his spear, becoming untargetable.

core_mechanics.summary: Vaults onto his spear and becomes untargetable.

citations.quote: Slamming the ground deals magic damage and slows nearby enemies.

core_mechanics.summary: Normal landing deals area magic damage and slows.

citations.quote: Fizz dashes to the target location, hopping down and splashing onto the ground prematurely upon arrival to deal the same magic damage in a smaller radius but not applying the slow.

core_mechanics.summary: Trickster adds a dash and an early, smaller landing without a slow.

purpose: Recognize untargetability and distinguish normal landing from the recast.
title: Playful / Trickster

citations.quote: Chum the Waters will not attach the lure to an enemy champion if they have a spell shield
The area of effect for the eruption will be at the target's location at the time of the attachment being blocked

advanced_exceptions.summary: A spell shield blocks attachment, but an eruption area still forms at the interception location.

citations.quote: The lure attaches to the first enemy champion that touches it, slowing them.
The lure's holder is slowed and revealed for the duration

core_mechanics.summary: Lure attachment slows and reveals its holder.

citations.quote: After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.

core_mechanics.summary: Delayed eruption damages and slows, knocking the holder up and nearby enemies aside.

citations.quote: The further the lure travels in its initial flight, the larger the shark that is attracted; increasing Chum the Waters' damage, slow, eruption radius and knock back distance.

core_mechanics.summary: Longer initial flight strengthens the eruption and enlarges its area.

purpose: Recognize lure attachment, delayed eruption and distance-based threat.
title: Chum the Waters
